an5.132:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño cakkavattissa jeṭṭho putto pitarā pavattitaṃ cakkaṃ dhammeneva anuppavatteti.
an5.132:1.2: taṃ hoti cakkaṃ appativattiyaṃkenaci manussabhūtena paccatthikena pāṇinā.
an5.132:2.2: idha bhikkhave rañño cakkavattissa jeṭṭho putto atthaññū ca hoti, dhammaññū ca, mattaññū ca, kālaññū ca, parisaññū ca.
an5.132:2.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño cakkavattissa jeṭṭho putto pitarā pavattitaṃ cakkaṃ dhammeneva anuppavatteti.
an5.132:2.4: taṃ hoti cakkaṃ appativattiyaṃ kenaci manussabhūtena paccatthikena pāṇinā.
an5.132:3.1: evameva kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato sāriputto tathāgatena pavattitaṃ anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ sammadeva anuppavatteti.
an5.132:3.2: taṃ hoti cakkaṃ appativattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.
an5.132:4.2: idha bhikkhave sāriputto atthaññū, dhammaññū, mattaññū, kālaññū, parisaññū.
an5.132:4.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato sāriputto tathāgatena anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ sammadeva anuppavatteti.
an5.132:4.4: taṃ hoti cakkaṃ appativattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasminti.
